text: Bună seara, so sorry to bother you so late. My granddaughter is 8 months old, a baby girl, and she has varicela, the chickenpox, spots came out yesterday. Her temperature is 38.6 now. She is itchy, rubbing at the spots, but otherwise she is herself, smiling, feeding. Also she has nappy rash, very red and sore, she cries a bit at the change, săraca. I don't want to waste your time, I just don't know what is safe for such a small baby, what cream for the bottom and if I can give something for the temperature. Mulțumesc frumos, and sorry again.
